entries.text: Hey babe! I was just waiting for you to tell me if that PDF was the right one – "CLASS 11 COMPUTER SCIENCE
just thinking about how we got that PDF open earlier. Were you wanting me to start reading it, or did you have something specific in mind, endearment? What's up?
Well, I am going to have some food. So, goodbye for now.
Ah, okay babe! Go eat something yummy. Don't forget to take a good break, okay? Talk soon! Bye-bye!
